rhythm.cutGrid: No strict grid. First 22.6 s: six long shots (median 2.85 s) joined by constructed transitions. Then a 38-frame origin, five 3–4 frame flashes, a 37-frame landing, a 2.5 s stat, a 3 s device shot, and an anthem of 29–36 frame plates cut on about every other beat. Tempo confidence 0.57: use the beat only for the anthem and the wordmark.

style: Premium, calm: deep brand-colour, warm off-white and white grounds; light neo-grotesque plus italic serif accent; one photoreal hero object; real interface; graded stock plates; small type on the centre band.

keep: Open on the category's old symbol and overturn it with one line within 6 s
Grow the hero object out of the thesis frame with no cut (frame → slab → action button → object)
Rising-sheet wipes with a long tail for changes of ground
Proof order: real interface, one real action, locations, use in the hand
Flash montage of 3–4 frame plates under one caption that keeps revealing
Anthem of about 1 s plates with a fixed lead phrase and an italic value word, ending on the viewer in the accent colour
Wordmark move repeated at open and close
Three grounds, one neo-grotesque, one italic serif, one accent colour; type small on the centre band
mustChange: branding: wordmark, product object design, colours chosen for the new brand
music: a new licensed track; time cuts by your own beat map
graphics: line-art figures, chips, sphere and all illustrations redrawn
copy: every line written new for the new product
interface: the new product's own captured interface, never a stand-in
footage: new licensed plates for every location and value
the wallet sheet: rebuilt from a fresh, dated screenshot of whatever platform the new product uses
